name: Clan - Default (seed v1)
description: A clan identity: name, colour, banner and optionally the town it defends by default. Siege teams take their name, colour and banner from a clan. There is no membership or ranks yet.

steps.description: How the clan is named and coloured in game.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown in siege menus and messages, and as the name of the clan's banner item. Up to 100 characters.

fields.label: Colour
fields.description: Colour of the clan's name in siege menus and messages, and of its team's capture effects on objectives.

fields.label: NPC clan
fields.description: A crown or garrison clan run by the server rather than by players. For information only: nothing in game treats NPC clans differently yet.

steps.description: The clan's banner, and the town it defends by default. Create the banner here if it doesn't exist yet.

fields.label: Banner
fields.description: Shown on objectives the clan's team holds in a siege and on its banner items. Create New opens the banner form; add its layers afterwards by editing the banner.

fields.label: Default clan for town
fields.description: Optional. A town has at most one default clan, which siege scenarios in that town list first when picking a team's clan. Empty = no home town.
